definition_en: a material that is burned for heat or power, or to give power to something
core_image: 汽车停在加油站，油枪正往里注油
scene: 这辆车的油箱快空了，得找地方加油。The car is low on fuel and needs to stop.
sceneCN: 这里 fuel 是「燃料」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这辆车的油箱快空了，得找地方加油。

senses.title: Material burned for power
senses.definition: a material such as wood, oil, or gas that is burned to produce heat or power
senses.definitionCN: 木柴、石油或天然气等燃烧后产生热或动力的材料
senses.example: The car is low on fuel and needs to stop.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车的油箱快空了，得找地方加油。
senses.why: This is the basic material sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的材料义项。

senses.title: Give power to
senses.definition: to give fuel to an engine or vehicle
senses.definitionCN: 为发动机或交通工具提供燃料
senses.example: The plane was fuelled before takeoff.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机起飞前加好了油。
senses.why: The noun became a verb of supplying.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示供给的动词。

senses.title: Make stronger
senses.definition: to make a feeling or situation stronger
senses.definitionCN: 使某种情绪或局势更强烈
senses.example: His words only fuelled the argument.
senses.exampleCN: 他的话只是让争论更激烈。
senses.why: Fuel feeds a fire, and also feeds conflict.
senses.whyCN: 燃料助长火焰，也助长冲突。

intro.en: Fuel came from Old French, with a Latin word for hearth behind it.
intro.cn: fuel 来自古法语，背后是拉丁语中表示壁炉的词。

items.en: The word entered English as fuel.

items.en: It widened to oil, gas, and other energy sources.
items.cn: 词义扩展到石油、天然气等能源。

items.en: The verb came to mean stirring up feeling.
items.cn: 动词义发展为激起情绪。

note.en: Fuel is compared with look-alike words and words for energy sources.
note.cn: 把 fuel 与形近词以及表示能源的词作比较。

definition_en: the purpose or role of something, a mathematical relation, or to work properly

senses.title: Work properly

definition_en: money kept for a purpose, a supply of something, or to provide money
core_image: 学校公告栏上贴着为新图书馆筹款的告示

definition_zh: 获得；增加；收益；（钟表）走快
definition_en: to get something useful, to increase in amount, or an increase or profit
core_image: 天平上的砝码一点点增加
scene: 她通过实习获得了宝贵的经验。She gained valuable experience through the internship.

senses.title: Obtain something useful
senses.definition: to obtain something valuable through effort
senses.definitionCN: 通过努力得到有价值的东西
senses.example: She gained valuable experience through the internship.
senses.exampleCN: 她通过实习获得了宝贵的经验。
senses.why: This is the core sense of earning something.
senses.whyCN: 这是通过努力得到某物的核心义项。

senses.title: Increase in amount
senses.definition: to increase in weight, speed, or amount
senses.definitionCN: 在重量、速度或数量上增长
senses.example: He gained five kilos during the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 他冬天重了五公斤。
senses.why: The word covers growth as well as earning.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既涵盖获得也涵盖增长。

senses.title: Profit or increase
senses.definition: an increase in money, advantage, or value
senses.definitionCN: 金钱、优势或价值上的增长
senses.example: The company reported a small gain this year.
senses.exampleCN: 公司今年报告了小幅收益。
senses.why: As a noun it names the increase itself.
senses.whyCN: 作名词时它指增长本身。

senses.title: Run fast by a clock
senses.definition: to run ahead of the correct time, used of a clock
senses.definitionCN: 指钟表比正确时间走得快
senses.example: The old clock gains three minutes a day.
senses.exampleCN: 这座旧钟每天快三分钟。
senses.why: A clock gains time as money gains value.
senses.whyCN: 钟表增加时间，如同金钱增加价值。

definition_en: a gravitationally bound system of stars, gas, dust and dark matter; the Milky Way
core_image: 哈勃拍的 Andromeda 星系，清晰的螺旋臂上点缀着粉蓝色的恒星形成区
scene: 纪录片里解说员说：The Milky Way is one galaxy among roughly two trillion in the observable universe, and it alone holds about 100 billion stars.
sceneCN: 这里指「由引力绑定的恒星系统」（第1个义项）；句意为银河系只是可观测宇宙中约两万亿个星系之一，而它本身就包含约一千亿颗恒星。

pos.zh: 星系；银河（大写 Galaxy 特指银河系）

derivatives.zh: 星云（常与 galaxy 混淆）

senses.title: A gravitationally bound system of stars
senses.titleCN: 由引力绑定的恒星系统
senses.definition: the core scientific sense: stars, gas, dust and dark matter held together by their own gravity, rotating around a central point
senses.definitionCN: 核心科学义项：恒星、气体、尘埃、暗物质靠自身引力绑定，绕中心旋转
senses.example: The Hubble image shows two galaxies merging together over millions of years.
senses.exampleCN: 哈勃图像展示两个星系在几百万年里合并。
senses.why: Greek galaxias meant 'milk-white' because of the Milky Way's appearance in the sky.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 galaxias 意为「乳白色的」，因为银河在天上看起来是乳白色的。

senses.title: The Milky Way (our home galaxy)
senses.definition: when capitalised as 'the Galaxy', refers specifically to the Milky Way, the one we live inside
senses.definitionCN: 大写 the Galaxy 特指银河系，就是我们居住的这个
senses.example: The Sun is located about 26,000 light-years from the centre of the Galaxy.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳位于距银河中心约 2.6 万光年处。
senses.why: Originally 'the galaxy' meant the Milky Way; other galaxies were 'island universes' until the 1920s.
senses.whyCN: 最初「the galaxy」就是指银河；其他星系在 1920 年代之前被视为「岛宇宙」。

senses.title: Galaxy types: spiral, elliptical, irregular
senses.titleCN: 星系类型：旋涡、椭圆、不规则
senses.definition: the Hubble tuning fork: spiral (with arms), elliptical (smooth), irregular (chaotic)
senses.definitionCN: 哈勃音叉：旋涡（有旋臂）、椭圆（平滑）、不规则（混沌）
senses.example: The Andromeda galaxy is a spiral, while M87 is an elliptical galaxy at the heart of a cluster.
senses.exampleCN: 仙女座星系是旋涡星系，而 M87 是一个星系团中心的椭圆星系。
senses.why: Hubble's 1920s classification is still the starting point for galaxy studies.
senses.whyCN: 哈勃 1920 年代的分类仍是星系研究的起点。

senses.title: Galaxy clusters and filaments
senses.definition: galaxies cluster together to form groups, clusters and filaments that shape the large-scale structure of the universe
senses.definitionCN: 星系聚在一起形成组、团、纤维，塑造宇宙的大尺度结构
senses.example: The Great Attractor is a mysterious mass pulling our local galaxy cluster toward it.
senses.exampleCN: 大吸引子是一个神秘的大质量体，把我们所在的星系团拉向它。
senses.why: Galaxy clusters are the largest objects held together by gravity in the universe.
senses.whyCN: 星系团是宇宙里最大的引力绑定物体。

senses.title: Supermassive black holes at galaxy centres
senses.titleCN: 星系中心的超大质量黑洞
senses.definition: almost every large galaxy has a supermassive black hole at its heart, including our own Milky Way (Sagittarius A*)
senses.definitionCN: 几乎每个大星系中心都有一个超大质量黑洞，包括我们的银河（人马座 A*）
senses.example: The Event Horizon Telescope imaged the black hole at the centre of the M87 galaxy.
senses.exampleCN: 事件视界望远镜拍到了 M87 星系中心黑洞的照片。
senses.why: Galaxy formation and black hole growth are tightly linked; each shapes the other.
senses.whyCN: 星系形成和黑洞成长紧密相连；互相塑造。

senses.title: Figurative: a large gathering
senses.definition: a galaxy of people or things — an impressive collection, like stars in a galaxy
senses.definitionCN: 一大群人或事物——令人印象深刻的集合，像星系里的恒星
senses.example: The gala featured a galaxy of Hollywood stars.
senses.exampleCN: 庆典有一整星系（一大群）好莱坞明星出席。
senses.why: People use galaxy for impressive gatherings because a galaxy is huge and packed with stars.
senses.whyCN: 人们用 galaxy 来形容一大群令人印象深刻的人，因为星系巨大又挤满恒星。

senses.title: Galactic centre and galactic year
senses.definition: galactic centre = the black hole at the Milky Way's heart; galactic year = the time the Sun takes to orbit the centre (~230 million years)
senses.definitionCN: 银心 = 银河系中心的黑洞；银河年 = 太阳绕中心一周的时间（约 2.3 亿年）
senses.example: The Sun is halfway through its 18th galactic year since forming.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳形成以来刚走完第 18 个银河年的一半。
senses.why: Using galaxy as the frame of reference gives us cosmic-scale time and distance units.
senses.whyCN: 用星系作参考系给了我们宇宙尺度的时间和距离单位。

senses.title: Galaxy vs nebula vs universe
senses.definition: nebula = cloud of gas and dust inside a galaxy; galaxy = system of stars; universe = everything
senses.definitionCN: nebula = 星系内的气体尘埃云；galaxy = 恒星系统；universe = 一切
senses.example: The Orion Nebula is inside our galaxy, not a galaxy itself.
senses.exampleCN: 猎户星云在我们的星系内部，本身不是星系。
senses.why: Popular media often confuses nebulae, galaxies and universes; astronomy draws clear lines.
senses.whyCN: 大众媒体常把星云、星系、宇宙搞混；天文学画了清楚的界线。

intro.en: galaxy comes from Greek galaxias, short for galaxias kyklos 'milky circle' — the Milky Way.
intro.cn: galaxy 来自希腊语 galaxias，是 galaxias kyklos「乳白的圆」的缩写——即银河。

items.en: galaxias 'milky' + kyklos 'circle' = the milky circle in the sky, the Milky Way.
items.cn: galaxias「乳白的」+ kyklos「圆」= 天上那个乳白的圆，即银河。

items.en: Latin galaxia kept both the 'milky' and 'circle' senses.
items.cn: 拉丁语 galaxia 保留了「乳白的」和「圆」两种意思。

items.en: Middle English galaxie (14th century) meant only the Milky Way.
items.cn: 中古英语 galaxie（14 世纪）只指银河。

items.en: Hubble's observations showed that 'spiral nebulae' were actually other galaxies, not part of our own.
items.cn: 哈勃的观测表明「旋涡星云」其实是别的星系，不是我们的一部分。

items.en: The Hubble telescope and later surveys established modern galaxy classification.
items.cn: 哈勃望远镜和后来的巡天建立了现代星系分类。

items.en: Two trillion galaxies are estimated to exist in the observable universe.
items.cn: 今天估计可观测宇宙里存在两万亿个星系。

note.en: Group one shares the galax- root; group two compares galaxy to nebula, universe and other sky objects.
note.cn: 第一组共享 galax- 词根；第二组把 galaxy 和 nebula, universe 等天体对比。

branches.en: Young people gather on a corner.
branches.cn: 年轻人聚在街角。

branches.en: Criminals organize as a group.
branches.cn: 罪犯组织成团伙。

branches.en: A group turns against one person.
branches.cn: 一群人转而对付一个人。

branches.en: Grouping and uniting are one process.
branches.cn: 成群与联合是同一个过程。

branches.en: Ganging up is the gang's method.
branches.cn: 结伙围攻是团伙的手法。

intro.en: Gang builds words for groups and passages.
intro.cn: gang 构成表示群体和通道的词。

items.example: A gang met behind the hall.

items.example: Rival gangs fought in the street.

items.exampleCN: 男孩们联合起来反对那条规则。

items.example: They were ganging up on the new student.
items.exampleCN: 他们正联合起来欺负新同学。

items.meaning: a leader of a work gang

items.meaning: a member of a criminal gang

definition_zh: 车库；汽车修理厂；把（车）停入车库
definition_en: a building where a car is kept, a place where cars are repaired, or to put a car in such a building
core_image: 一栋带卷帘门的车库，里面停着一辆家用汽车
scene: 他把车开进车库，熄了火。He parked the car in the garage.
sceneCN: 这里 garage 是「车库」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他把车开进车库，熄了火。

collocations.phrase: take the car to the garage

senses.title: Building for a car
senses.definition: a building next to or part of a house where a car is kept
senses.definitionCN: 紧邻房屋或属于房屋、用来停放汽车的建筑物
senses.example: He parked the car in the garage.
senses.exampleCN: 他把车开进车库，熄了火。
senses.why: This is the everyday sense for a private car.
senses.whyCN: 这是私家车最常见的义项。

senses.title: Place for repairs
senses.definition: a business where cars are repaired and serviced
senses.definitionCN: 修理和保养汽车的营业场所
senses.example: The garage fixed the brakes in a day.
senses.exampleCN: 修理厂一天就修好了刹车。
senses.why: The building word extends to shops that service cars.
senses.whyCN: 这个表示建筑物的词扩展到维修汽车的场所。

senses.title: Put a car inside
senses.definition: to put a car into a garage
senses.definitionCN: 把汽车停放进车库
senses.example: She garaged the car before the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨来临前她把车停进了车库。
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb of placing.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示放置的动词。

intro.en: Garage came from French, where it first named a place of shelter.
intro.cn: garage 来自法语，最初指提供庇护的场所。

items.en: Garer meant to shelter or bring a boat to port.
items.cn: garer 意为庇护或把船引进港口。

items.en: Garage first named a place where boats were sheltered.
items.cn: garage 最初指船只停泊受护之处。

items.en: English borrowed garage for a building that houses cars.
items.cn: 英语借入 garage，指停放汽车的建筑物。

items.en: The word spread to shops that repair vehicles.
items.cn: 词义扩展到维修车辆的店铺。

items.en: It also became a verb meaning to put a car away.
items.cn: 它又成为动词，表示把车收进车库。

note.en: Garage is compared with look-alike words and words for places that hold or fix cars.
note.cn: 把 garage 与形近词以及表示停车或修车场所的词作比较。

entries.definition: waste material that is thrown away
a small room at the top of a house
a shelter for a car with a roof but no walls
a room or building where things are repaired
a place where vehicles are kept

normalIntro.en: A garage is the roofed place where a car sleeps at night.
normalIntro.cn: garage 是汽车夜里安睡的有顶之处。

normal.en: He parked the car in the garage.
normal.cn: 他把车开进车库，熄了火。

normal.en: The garage door would not close.
normal.cn: 车库门关不上了。

normal.en: They held a garage sale on Sunday.
normal.cn: 他们周日在车库里办旧货出售。

normal.en: The garage fixed the brakes in a day.
normal.cn: 修理厂一天就修好了刹车。

normal.en: She garaged the car before the storm.
normal.cn: 暴风雨前她把车停进了车库。

abstract.en: A garage is a small promise that the journey can wait.
abstract.cn: 车库是一个小小的承诺：旅程可以等到明天。

abstract.en: We shelter machines the way we shelter our tired bodies.
abstract.cn: 我们庇护机器，就像庇护疲惫的身体。

abstract.en: A closed door does not stop the road from existing.
abstract.cn: 关上的门并不能让道路消失。

examples.en: He parked the car in the garage.
examples.cn: 他把车开进车库，熄了火。

examples.en: The garage fixed the brakes in a day.
examples.cn: 修理厂一天就修好了刹车。

examples.en: She garaged the car before the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨来临前她把车停进了车库。

dict_mnemonic.text: garage 与 garbage 只差一个字母；garage sale 是「车库旧货出售」，park in the garage 是「把车停进车库」。

root: 来自法语 garer（停放、庇护），原指船只停泊受护之处，后指停放汽车的建筑物。

sensesIntro.en: Garage means a building for a car, a shop that repairs cars, or the act of putting a car inside.
sensesIntro.cn: garage 意为停放汽车的建筑、修理汽车的店铺，或把车停进车库的动作。

core.en: A sheltered place where a car rests.
core.cn: 汽车在其中安放的有顶之处。

branches.en: A car rests under a private roof.
branches.cn: 汽车停在私人的屋顶之下。

branches.en: Machines are mended in a public shop.
branches.cn: 机器在营业的店铺里被修好。

branches.en: The car is driven inside and shut away.
branches.cn: 车被开进屋里关起来。

branches.en: Parking and repair share one word and one roof.
branches.cn: 停车与修车共用一个词、一片屋顶。

branches.en: The building and the act of storing belong together.
branches.cn: 建筑物与收纳动作彼此相属。

intro.en: Garage builds words for car storage and car repair.
intro.cn: garage 构成表示停车和修车的词。

latinIntro.en: The French source garer meant to shelter or moor.
latinIntro.cn: 法语来源 garer 意为庇护或停泊。

items.example: The garage is beside the house.
The street has narrow garages.
items.exampleCN: 这条街上的车库都很窄。

items.example: The car was garaged all winter.
items.exampleCN: 这辆车整个冬天都停在车库里。

items.meaning: the act of storing a car
items.example: Garaging costs extra in the city.
items.exampleCN: 在城里停车要额外花钱。

items.meaning: a person who runs a garage
items.example: The garagist checked the engine.
items.exampleCN: 修理厂老板检查了发动机。

items.example: The garage door opened slowly.

items.meaning: a sale of used goods at home
items.example: We found a lamp at a garage sale.
items.exampleCN: 我们在车库旧货出售上找到一盏灯。

items.example: The house has a two-car garage.
items.exampleCN: 这栋房子有一个双车位车库。

definition_zh: 气体；燃气；汽油；给（车）加油
definition_en: a substance like air, fuel burned for heat, petrol in American use, or to fill a car with fuel
core_image: 气球被气体撑得鼓起来
scene: 气球里充满了气体。The balloon is full of gas.
sceneCN: 这里 gas 是「气体」（第 1 个义项）；句意：气球里充满了气体。

senses.title: Substance like air
senses.definition: a substance that is not solid or liquid and spreads to fill a space
senses.definitionCN: 既非固体也非液体、会扩散充满空间的物质
senses.example: The balloon is full of gas.
senses.exampleCN: 气球里充满了气体。
senses.why: This is the scientific and general sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是科学和日常通用的义项。

senses.title: Fuel for heat
senses.definition: a flammable gas burned for cooking or heating
senses.definitionCN: 用于烹饪或取暖的可燃气体
senses.example: The gas stove is easy to light.
senses.exampleCN: 这个煤气灶很容易点着。
senses.why: Household fuel is the most common concrete sense.
senses.whyCN: 家用燃料是最常见的具体义项。

senses.title: Petrol
senses.definition: petrol, especially in American English
senses.definitionCN: 汽油，尤用于美式英语
senses.example: We need gas before the next town.
senses.exampleCN: 到下一个镇之前我们得加油。
senses.why: American speech uses gas for motor fuel.
senses.whyCN: 美式口语用 gas 指汽车燃料。

senses.title: Fill with fuel
senses.definition: to fill a vehicle with fuel
senses.definitionCN: 给车辆加满燃料
senses.example: He gassed up the car at the station.
senses.exampleCN: 他在加油站给车加了油。
senses.why: The noun became a verb of refuelling.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示加油的动词。

intro.en: Gas was coined by a chemist from a Greek word for empty space.
intro.cn: gas 是化学家根据希腊语中表示虚空的词创造的。

items.en: Khaos described empty space or a gap.
items.cn: khaos 描述虚空或空隙。

items.en: Van Helmont coined gas from that Greek word.
items.cn: 范海尔蒙特根据那个希腊词创造了 gas。

items.en: English adopted gas for vapours and airs.
items.cn: 英语借入 gas 表示蒸汽和气体。

items.en: It widened to coal gas and natural gas.
items.cn: 词义扩展到煤气和天然气。

items.en: American speech made gas a word for petrol.
items.cn: 美式口语使 gas 成为汽油的叫法。

note.en: Gas is compared with look-alike words and other words for air, vapour, and fuel.
note.cn: 把 gas 与形近词以及表示空气、蒸气和燃料的词作比较。

entries.definition: an empty space between two things
to give an answer without being sure
a gas that comes from a liquid or solid
the mixture of gases around the earth

normalIntro.en: Gas is matter that spreads out and fills whatever holds it.
normalIntro.cn: gas 是会扩散并充满容器的物质。

normal.en: The balloon is full of gas.
normal.cn: 气球里充满了气体。

normal.en: The gas stove is easy to light.
normal.cn: 这个煤气灶很容易点着。

normal.en: We need gas before the next town.
normal.cn: 到下一个镇之前我们得加油。

normal.en: He gassed up the car at the station.
normal.cn: 他在加油站给车加了油。

normal.en: Greenhouse gas traps heat in the air.
normal.cn: 温室气体把热量困在空气中。

abstract.en: A gas takes the shape of whatever holds it.
abstract.cn: 气体随容器而改变形状。

abstract.en: Invisible things can still move a whole room.
abstract.cn: 看不见的东西也能搅动整个房间。

abstract.en: We notice the air only when it is taken away.
abstract.cn: 空气被夺走时我们才注意到它。

examples.en: The balloon is full of gas.
examples.cn: 气球里充满了气体。

examples.en: We need gas before the next town.
examples.cn: 到下一个镇之前我们得加油。

examples.en: He gassed up the car at the station.

dict_mnemonic.text: gas 与 gap、gasp 形近；gas station 是「加油站」，gas up 是「加油」，natural gas 是「天然气」。

root: 由荷兰化学家范海尔蒙特依据希腊语 khaos（虚空）创造，后泛指气体、燃气，并在美式英语中指汽油。

sensesIntro.en: Gas is a substance like air, household fuel, petrol in American use, or the act of refuelling.
sensesIntro.cn: gas 指类似空气的物质、家用燃气、美式英语中的汽油，或加油的动作。

core.en: Invisible matter that spreads to fill space.
core.cn: 扩散充满空间的不可见物质。

branches.en: A light substance fills a balloon.
branches.cn: 轻盈的物质充满气球。

branches.en: A flame burns at the stove.
branches.cn: 灶上燃起火焰。

branches.en: A car drinks fuel at the pump.
branches.cn: 汽车在油泵旁喝下燃料。

branches.en: A driver fills the tank before a trip.
branches.cn: 司机出发前把油箱加满。

branches.en: The same word names the substance and the fuel made from it.
branches.cn: 同一个词既指物质，也指由它制成的燃料。

intro.en: Gas builds words for states of matter, fuel, and refuelling.
intro.cn: gas 构成表示物态、燃料和加油的词。

latinIntro.en: The word was coined in Dutch from Greek khaos, meaning empty space.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词在荷兰语中依据希腊语 khaos（虚空）创造。

items.example: Some gases are lighter than air.
The lab stores several gases.
items.exampleCN: 实验室储存着几种气体。

items.meaning: in the form of a gas
items.example: Water becomes gaseous when it boils.
The plant gasifies coal.
The gas station is open all night.
The gas stove has four burners.
items.exampleCN: 这个煤气灶有四个灶眼。

items.meaning: gas found underground and used as fuel
items.example: The house is heated by natural gas.
items.exampleCN: 这栋房子用天然气供暖。

items.meaning: to fill a vehicle with fuel
items.example: We gassed up before leaving.

latinEntries.example: The Greek word khaos meant a void.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 希腊语 khaos 意为虚空。

definition_en: to come together, to collect things, to understand from evidence, or to increase gradually
core_image: 广场上的人们从四面聚拢到一起
scene: 人群在广场上聚集起来。A crowd gathered in the square.
sceneCN: 这里 gather 是「聚集」（第 1 个义项）；句意：人群在广场上聚集起来。

senses.title: Come together
senses.definition: to come together in one place
senses.definitionCN: 来到同一个地方聚在一起
senses.example: A crowd gathered in the square.
senses.exampleCN: 人群在广场上聚集起来。
senses.why: This is the central sense of people meeting.
senses.whyCN: 这是人们会合的核心义项。

senses.title: Collect things
senses.definition: to bring things together from different places
senses.definitionCN: 从不同地方把东西收拢到一起
senses.example: They gathered wood for the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 他们捡来木柴生火。
senses.why: The word extends from people to objects.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从人扩展到物品。

senses.title: Understand from clues
senses.definition: to understand something from the information available
senses.definitionCN: 根据已有信息理解某事
senses.example: I gather that the meeting was cancelled.
senses.exampleCN: 我推断会议取消了。
senses.why: Pieces of evidence are mentally collected.
senses.whyCN: 证据的碎片在头脑中被收拢起来。

senses.title: Increase gradually
senses.definition: to gradually gain speed, strength, or force
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐获得速度、力量或势头
senses.example: The train gathered speed down the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 火车下山时越来越快。
senses.why: Force is pictured as something being collected.
senses.whyCN: 力量被想象成不断被收集起来的东西。

intro.en: Gather is an Old English verb for bringing things into one place.
intro.cn: gather 是古英语动词，意为把东西聚到一处。

items.en: Gaderian meant to bring together or unite.
items.cn: gaderian 意为聚拢或联合。

items.en: Related forms in other Germanic languages shared the sense.
items.cn: 其他日耳曼语中的相关形式也有同样的意思。

items.en: The verb took the form gaderen and later gather.
items.cn: 这个动词先后写作 gaderen 和 gather。

items.en: It widened to collecting crops, facts, and evidence.
items.cn: 词义扩展到收割庄稼、收集事实和证据。

items.en: It also came to mean drawing a conclusion.
items.cn: 它也发展为得出结论的意思。

note.en: Gather is compared with look-alike words and other verbs of bringing together.
note.cn: 把 gather 与形近词以及其他表示聚拢的动词作比较。

entries.definition: a band worn around the leg
a channel at the edge of a road
to shine with small bright flashes
to bring people or parts together

normalIntro.en: To gather is to make many separate things into one group.
normalIntro.cn: gather 就是把许多分散的东西变成一个整体。

normal.en: A crowd gathered in the square.
normal.cn: 人群在广场上聚集起来。

normal.en: They gathered wood for the fire.
normal.cn: 他们捡来木柴生火。

normal.en: I gather that the meeting was cancelled.
normal.cn: 我推断会议取消了。

normal.en: The train gathered speed down the hill.
normal.cn: 火车下山时越来越快。

normal.en: We gathered around the small table.
normal.cn: 我们围拢在小桌旁。

abstract.en: Attention gathers what the eye alone would scatter.
abstract.cn: 注意力把眼睛本会散落的东西聚拢起来。

abstract.en: A community begins when people gather for no practical reason.
abstract.cn: 人们为没有实际目的的事情聚在一起时，社群就开始了。

abstract.en: Small facts gather into understanding.
abstract.cn: 细小的事实汇聚成理解。

examples.en: A crowd gathered in the square.
examples.cn: 人群在广场上聚集起来。

examples.en: They gathered wood for the fire.
examples.cn: 他们捡来木柴生火。

examples.en: I gather that the meeting was cancelled.
examples.cn: 我推断会议取消了。

dict_mnemonic.text: gather 与 together 同源，都含「聚到一起」的意思；gather speed 是「加速」，gather information 是「收集信息」。

root: 古英语 gaderian（聚拢、联合），与 together 同源，核心义「把分散之物聚到一处」。

sensesIntro.en: Gather means to come together, to collect, to infer, or to increase gradually.
sensesIntro.cn: gather 意为聚到一起、收集、推断，或逐渐增加。

core.en: Separate parts brought into one place.
core.cn: 把分散的部分聚到一处。

branches.en: People arrive until they form a crowd.
branches.cn: 人们陆续到来，直到围成一群。

branches.en: Hands pick up wood and crops.
branches.cn: 双手捡起木柴和庄稼。

branches.en: Clues are joined into a conclusion.
branches.cn: 线索被拼接成结论。

branches.en: Speed builds as a train rolls downhill.
branches.cn: 火车下坡时速度不断累积。

branches.en: People and things are both brought together.
branches.cn: 人与物都会被聚拢到一起。

intro.en: Gather builds words for meetings and for people who collect.
intro.cn: gather 构成表示聚会和采集者的词。

latinIntro.en: The verb is Germanic in origin and has no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: 这个动词源于日耳曼语，没有拉丁语词根。

items.example: People gather here every evening.
items.exampleCN: 人们每天傍晚在这里聚集。

items.example: She gathers herbs in the morning.
They gathered at the gate.
It was a quiet family gathering.
items.exampleCN: 那是一次安静的家庭聚会。

items.example: The gatherer filled a basket with berries.
items.exampleCN: 采集者用浆果装满了篮子。

items.meaning: to come close in a group
items.example: The children gathered around the fire.
The bus gathered speed on the straight road.
items.exampleCN: 公交车在直路上加快了速度。

items.example: The police gathered evidence for weeks.
items.exampleCN: 警方收集证据达数周之久。

definition_en: to look steadily at something for a long time, or a long steady look
core_image: 一个人久久望着夜空中的星星
scene: 她盯着星星看了几个小时。She gazed at the stars for hours.
sceneCN: 这里 gaze 是「凝视」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她盯着星星看了几个小时。

senses.title: Look steadily
senses.definition: to look at something steadily for a long time
senses.definitionCN: 长时间稳定地看着某物
senses.example: She gazed at the stars for hours.
senses.exampleCN: 她盯着星星看了几个小时。
senses.why: This is the core verb sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的动词义项。

senses.title: A steady look
senses.definition: a long, steady look at someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 长时间稳定地投向某人或某物的目光
senses.example: He held her gaze across the room.
senses.exampleCN: 隔着房间，他一直与她对视。
senses.why: The verb also names the look itself.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词也用来指目光本身。

senses.title: Look in wonder
senses.definition: to look with wonder or deep thought
senses.definitionCN: 带着惊叹或深思地看
senses.example: The child gazed into the shop window.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子出神地望着商店橱窗。
senses.why: Long looking often carries feeling.
senses.whyCN: 长久的观看常常带着情绪。

intro.en: Gaze appeared in Middle English, probably from a Scandinavian source.
intro.cn: gaze 在中古英语中出现，可能来自斯堪的纳维亚语。

items.en: A related northern word meant to stare or look.
items.cn: 一个相关的北方词语意为注视或看。

items.en: Gazen meant to look long and steadily.
items.cn: gazen 意为长久而稳定地看。

items.en: The verb settled in the form gaze.
items.cn: 这个动词固定为 gaze 的形式。

items.en: It also became a noun for a steady look.
items.cn: 它也成为名词，表示稳定的目光。

items.en: Writers gave it the sense of looking in wonder.
items.cn: 作家赋予它惊叹地观看的含义。

note.en: Gaze is compared with look-alike words and other verbs of looking.
note.cn: 把 gaze 与形近词以及其他表示看的动词作比较。

entries.definition: a door in a fence or wall
to look directly for a long time
to look at something for a period of time

normalIntro.en: To gaze is to let the eyes rest on one thing.
normalIntro.cn: gaze 就是让目光停留在一样东西上。

normal.en: She gazed at the stars for hours.
normal.cn: 她盯着星星看了几个小时。

normal.en: He held her gaze across the room.
normal.cn: 隔着房间，他一直与她对视。

normal.en: The child gazed into the shop window.
normal.cn: 孩子出神地望着商店橱窗。

normal.en: They gazed at the sea in silence.
normal.cn: 他们默默地望着大海。

normal.en: She lowered her gaze and smiled.
normal.cn: 她垂下目光笑了。

abstract.en: A gaze is attention with nowhere else to go.
abstract.cn: 凝视是别无他处的注意力。

abstract.en: What we look at long enough begins to look back.
abstract.cn: 我们看久了的东西也开始回望我们。

abstract.en: Some questions are asked only with the eyes.
abstract.cn: 有些问题只用眼睛来问。

examples.en: She gazed at the stars for hours.
examples.cn: 她盯着星星看了几个小时。

examples.en: The child gazed into the shop window.
examples.cn: 孩子出神地望着商店橱窗。

examples.en: He held her gaze across the room.
examples.cn: 隔着房间，他一直与她对视。

dict_mnemonic.text: gaze 与 gate、gale 形近；gaze at 是「凝视」，meet someone's gaze 是「与某人对视」。

root: 中古英语 gazen（长久注视），可能来自斯堪的纳维亚语，核心义「目光停留在某处」。

sensesIntro.en: Gaze means to look steadily, the steady look itself, or to look in wonder.
sensesIntro.cn: gaze 意为稳定地看、那种稳定的目光，或出神地观看。

core.en: The eyes resting on one thing.
core.cn: 目光停留在一样东西上。

branches.en: The eyes stay on a distant star.
branches.cn: 目光停留在远处的星星上。

branches.en: Two people hold each other's look.
branches.cn: 两个人彼此接住对方的目光。

branches.en: A child stands lost before a window.
branches.cn: 孩子站在橱窗前出了神。

branches.en: The act of looking and the look itself share one word.
branches.cn: 看的动作与目光本身共用一个词。

branches.en: A long look can carry wonder or feeling.
branches.cn: 长久的注视可以带着惊叹或情感。

intro.en: Gaze builds words for people who look and for stargazing.
intro.cn: gaze 构成表示观看者和观星的词。

latinIntro.en: The word is probably Scandinavian in origin and has no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词可能源于斯堪的纳维亚语，没有拉丁语词根。

items.example: Do not gaze at the sun.
She gazes out of the window every morning.
items.exampleCN: 她每天早上都望着窗外。

items.example: He gazed at the painting for a long time.
She sat gazing at the fire.
The gazer stood still at the edge.
items.exampleCN: 凝视者一动不动地站在边缘。

items.meaning: a person who watches the stars
items.example: Stargazers met on the hill at night.
items.exampleCN: 观星者夜里在山丘上相聚。

items.example: They gazed at the empty road.
She answered with a steady gaze.

definition_en: a toothed wheel that passes power, a speed setting in a vehicle, equipment for an activity, or to adjust something to fit
core_image: 变速箱里互相咬合的金属齿轮
scene: 他在山坡上换了挡。He changed gear on the hill.
sceneCN: 这里 gear 是「排挡」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他在山坡上换了挡。

senses.title: Toothed wheel
senses.definition: a wheel with teeth that turns another wheel and passes power
senses.definitionCN: 带齿、能带动另一个轮子并传递动力的轮子
senses.example: The gears in the clock turn slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 钟里的齿轮转得很慢。
senses.why: This is the mechanical sense at the centre of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词核心的机械义项。

senses.title: Speed setting
senses.definition: one of the settings that control a vehicle's speed and power
senses.definitionCN: 控制车辆速度和动力的挡位之一
senses.example: He changed gear on the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 他在山坡上换了挡。
senses.why: A vehicle's gears are named as a set.
senses.whyCN: 车辆的挡位被作为一组来称呼。

senses.title: Equipment
senses.definition: the clothes and tools needed for an activity
senses.definitionCN: 某项活动所需的衣物和工具
senses.example: They packed their climbing gear.
senses.exampleCN: 他们收拾好了攀登装备。
senses.why: The word extends from machinery to personal kit.
senses.whyCN: 词义从机械扩展到个人装备。

senses.title: Adjust to fit
senses.definition: to organize something so that it suits a purpose or group
senses.definitionCN: 调整某物，使其适合某个目的或群体
senses.example: The course is geared to beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课程是为初学者设计的。
senses.why: Things are adjusted the way wheels are meshed.
senses.whyCN: 调整事物就像让齿轮互相咬合。

intro.en: Gear came from Old Norse and first meant equipment or apparel.
intro.cn: gear 来自古诺尔斯语，最初意为装备或衣物。

items.en: Gervi meant equipment or clothing.
items.cn: gervi 意为装备或衣物。

items.en: The word entered English as gear.
items.cn: 这个词以 gear 进入英语。

items.en: It came to name the parts that pass power in a machine.
items.cn: 它开始指机器中传递动力的部件。

items.en: Vehicles gave it the sense of a speed setting.
items.cn: 车辆赋予它挡位的意思。

items.en: The verb came to mean adjusting something to fit.
items.cn: 动词义发展为调整某物使之适合。

note.en: Gear is compared with look-alike words and words for equipment and wheels.
note.cn: 把 gear 与形近词以及表示装备和轮子的词作比较。

entries.definition: to notice sound with the ears
the things needed for a purpose
a tooth on a wheel or a small gear
a set of tools or clothes for an activity

normalIntro.cn: gear 既是传递动力的轮子，也是人携带的装备。

normal.cn: 他在山坡上换了挡。

abstract.cn: 小小的轮齿能带动很大的轮子。

abstract.en: Preparation is a kind of gear we put on.
abstract.cn: 准备是我们穿上的一种装备。

abstract.en: Nothing moves alone in a well-built machine.
abstract.cn: 在造得好的机器里，没有部件独自转动。

dict_mnemonic.text: gear 与 fear、hear 形近；change gear 是「换挡」，fishing gear 是「钓鱼装备」，gear up 是「做好准备」。

root: 来自古诺尔斯语 gervi（装备、衣物），后指机器中传递动力的齿轮和车辆挡位。

sensesIntro.en: Gear is a toothed wheel, a vehicle's speed setting, equipment, or the act of adjusting to fit.
sensesIntro.cn: gear 指齿轮、车辆挡位、装备，或调整使之适合。

core.en: Parts that fit together to move power.
core.cn: 互相咬合以传递动力的部件。

branches.en: Teeth on a wheel pass motion along.
branches.cn: 轮上的齿把运动传递下去。

branches.en: A driver selects the right speed.
branches.cn: 驾驶者选择合适的挡位。

branches.en: A climber carries the needed kit.
branches.cn: 攀登者携带所需的装备。

branches.en: A course is adjusted to its learners.
branches.cn: 课程被调整以适合学习者。

branches.en: Mechanical fitting and social fitting share one word.
branches.cn: 机械咬合与社会适应共用一个词。

intro.en: Gear builds words for gearboxes, equipment, and preparation.
intro.cn: gear 构成表示变速箱、装备和准备的词。
